_note: Menu display strings only. en is the source literal (also the ini key / strcmp subject); zh is the Simplified Chinese text drawn when Menu language = Chinese. Generated/kept in sync with scripts/gen_menu_i18n.py.

entries.en: 5.1 when the default output device has 5.1 or more speakers, else stereo.
entries.zh: 默认输出设备有 5.1 或更多声道时用 5.1，否则用立体声。

entries.en: 5.1, whatever the device has. Mixed down on stereo speakers.
entries.zh: 无论设备如何都用 5.1。 在立体声扬声器上会混缩。

entries.en: A at the bottom (action and talk), B on the right, X on the left, Y at the top.
entries.zh: A 在下（动作与对话）、B 在右、X 在左、Y 在上。

entries.en: A at the bottom, B on the right; X and Y as on the Switch.
entries.zh: A 在下、B 在右；X 和 Y 与 Switch 一致。

entries.en: A draw keeps its descriptors while the texture slots it samples are unchanged, so streaming elsewhere in the game no longer rebuilds every set each frame. Applies after restart.
entries.zh: 一次绘制所采样的纹理槽未变时 保留其描述符，这样游戏别处流式加载纹理时 不必每帧重建所有描述符集。 重启后生效。

entries.en: A frame for each of the display's refreshes: none made when the game keeps up. Frame pacing does not apply.
entries.zh: 按显示器每次刷新生成一帧：游戏跟得上时不生成。 帧同步设置不生效。

entries.en: A steady size: lower is faster, and softer.
entries.zh: 固定尺寸：越低越快，也越柔和。

entries.en: A step each frame: the game slows down whenever it runs below 60 fps.
entries.zh: 每帧推进一步：低于 60 fps 时 游戏会变慢。

entries.en: AMD GPUs: each frame starts as late as it can, for less input delay. Not used with frame generation.
entries.zh: AMD 显卡：让每帧尽可能晚地开始渲染，以降低输入延迟。开启插帧时不生效。

entries.en: AMD's machine-learned upscaler, from a smaller 3D, with AMD's files beside the game. Things that move by themselves can trail for now.
entries.zh: AMD 的机器学习缩放器，从较低分辨率的 3D 放大，需把 AMD 的文件放在游戏目录旁。目前自行移动的物体可能拖影。

entries.en: AMD's machine-learned upscaler, the 3D at full size with its edges smoothed; the slowest.
entries.zh: AMD 的机器学习缩放器，以全尺寸 3D 做边缘平滑；速度最慢。

entries.en: AMD's, from a smaller 3D, on any GPU: built from AMD's own shaders. Things that move by themselves can trail for now.
entries.zh: AMD 方案：从较低分辨率 3D 放大，任意 GPU 可用，基于 AMD 着色器。 自行移动的物体目前可能有拖影。

entries.en: Aims and looks with the controller's gyroscope where the game uses motion, as on the Switch. Works with Switch Pro controllers and pads in Switch mode, DualSense and DualShock 4. Shown beside it: whether the connected pad has one.
entries.zh: 在游戏用到体感的地方 用手柄陀螺仪瞄准和观察视角，与 Switch 上一致。 支持 Switch Pro 手柄、Switch 模式的手柄、DualSense 和 DualShock 4。 旁边会显示所连接手柄是否有陀螺仪。

entries.en: Also behind other windows, for streaming or other apps. The keyboard and mouse still need the game's window.
entries.zh: 在其它窗口之后也继续，便于直播或使用其它应用。 键盘鼠标仍需游戏窗口焦点。

entries.en: As On, and the GPU's clocks are kept up as well.
entries.zh: 同开启，并同时保持 GPU 频率。

entries.en: As in the hands: the game at the console's handheld size (1536x864), lighter on the GPU.
entries.zh: 如掌机模式：游戏按主机掌机尺寸（1536x864）渲染，GPU 负担更轻。

entries.en: As on a TV: the game at the Output resolution's size.
entries.zh: 如电视模式：游戏按输出分辨率的尺寸渲染。

entries.en: As soon as it is ready.
At an even interval: less stutter, at up to one frame of delay.
entries.zh: 按均匀间隔显示：卡顿更少，最多增加一帧延迟。

entries.en: Between Native and Quality: sharper than Quality, a little slower.
entries.zh: 介于原生与质量之间：比质量更锐利，稍慢一点。
介于性能与超级性能之间。

entries.en: Bindings of your own, from the Controls page.
entries.zh: 来自控制页面的自定义绑定。

entries.en: Bounds-checked buffer reads: a read past a buffer's end is dropped instead of stopping the GPU. Applies after a restart.
entries.zh: 缓冲区读取边界检查：越过缓冲区末尾的读取 会被丢弃，而不至于让 GPU 停止。 重启后生效。

entries.en: Can be faster on some NVIDIA cards.
entries.zh: 在部分 NVIDIA 显卡上可能更快。

entries.en: Choose Edit amount, then use Left and Right to change the quantity.
entries.zh: 选择「编辑数量」，再用左／右方向键调整数量。

entries.en: Choose a consumable with Left or Right.
Choose an hour with Left or Right. Enter sets the world clock.
entries.zh: 用左右键选择小时。Enter 设置世界时间。

entries.en: Choose how many to add or remove. Enter applies the change.
entries.zh: 选择增加或减少的数量。Enter 确认修改。

entries.en: DLAA: the 3D at the picture's full size, anti-aliased by DLSS. The sharpest, and the heaviest.
entries.zh: DLAA：以画面全尺寸渲染 3D，再由 DLSS 做抗锯齿。最锐利，也最吃性能。

entries.en: DLSS and DLAA: DLSS's runtime was not found (the game folder's ngx folder, see the readme).
entries.zh: DLSS/DLAA：未找到 DLSS 运行库（游戏文件夹的 ngx 目录，见说明）。

entries.en: DLSS and DLAA: NVIDIA's NGX on Linux loads DLSS's runtime only from a folder named in ASCII (see the readme).
entries.zh: DLSS/DLAA：Linux 上 NVIDIA NGX 只能从纯 ASCII 名称的目录加载 DLSS 运行库（见说明）。

entries.en: DLSS and DLAA: need a newer NVIDIA driver.
entries.zh: 需要更新 NVIDIA 驱动。

entries.en: DLSS and DLAA: need an NVIDIA RTX GPU.
entries.zh: 需要 NVIDIA RTX 显卡。

entries.en: DLSS and DLAA: not in this build (built without NVIDIA's DLSS SDK, see the readme).
entries.zh: DLSS/DLAA：本版本未编入（缺少 NVIDIA DLSS SDK，见说明）。

entries.en: DLSS and DLAA: off for this run (RX_VK_DLSS=0).
Each page at once, as pressing A does.
entries.zh: 整页一次显示，如同按下 A 键。

entries.en: Each row as you set it. Changing most rows yourself comes back to Custom.
entries.zh: 各行按你的设置显示。 手动修改大多数行后 会回到自定义。

entries.en: Enable double-tap Jump for takeoff and landing. Hold Jump to climb or L to descend.
entries.zh: 双击跳跃键起飞和降落。按住跳跃键上升，按 L 下降。

entries.en: Enter opens the inventory editor: unlock or relock equipment, items, upgrades and quest items, and change amounts.
entries.zh: Enter 打开背包编辑器： 解锁或重新锁定装备、道具、强化和任务物品， 并修改数量。

entries.en: FSR 4's native AA: the 3D at the picture's full size. The sharpest, and the heaviest.
entries.zh: FSR 4 原生抗锯齿：以画面全尺寸渲染 3D。最锐利，也最吃性能。

entries.en: FSR's Performance mode, 2x: faster, and softer.
entries.zh: FSR 性能模式，2x：更快，但更柔和。

entries.en: FSR's Ultra Performance mode, 3x: its fastest, and its softest.
entries.zh: FSR 极速模式，3x：最快也最柔和。

entries.en: Fills the whole screen with the game, without the window's border. The same as F11.
entries.zh: 游戏画面铺满整个屏幕，不显示窗口边框。等同于 F11 键。

entries.en: Frames per second in the top right corner.
entries.zh: 在右上角显示每秒帧数。

entries.en: Gamepad: the D-pad moves, A binds, B goes back.
entries.zh: 手柄：十字键移动，A 绑定，B 返回。

entries.en: HDR10 out on an HDR display (Windows: Use HDR on in the display settings). Expanded: the game's SDR picture, its white at the paper white and its highlights up to the peak. Native: the game's own HDR, told the display's peak and paper white.
entries.zh: 在 HDR 显示器上输出 HDR10（Windows 需在显示设置中打开 HDR）。 扩展：游戏 SDR 画面按纸白与峰值亮度拉伸。 原生：使用游戏自带 HDR，并向显示器报告峰值与纸白。

entries.en: How bright the picture's white is with HDR on. Around 200 for a normal room; higher in a bright one.
entries.zh: 开启 HDR 时 画面白色的亮度。 普通房间约 200，明亮环境可调高。

entries.en: How far a stick moves before the game sees it, on each axis. Lower for a precise stick, higher for one that drifts. The game's own dead zone still follows.
entries.zh: 摇杆在各轴上移动多少 游戏才开始响应。 精准摇杆可调低，漂移的摇杆调高。 游戏自身的死区仍然生效。

entries.en: How far the camera turns for a mouse movement, with either Mouse camera: at 1.00 native look turns 0.1 degree a count. The - and = keys change it in game too.
entries.zh: 一次鼠标移动 让镜头转过多少，两种鼠标视角模式都适用： 原生视角在 1.00 时 每个计数转 0.1 度。 游戏中也可用 - 和 = 键调整。

entries.en: How fast Link walks, runs and swims, as a multiple of his own speed. Choose with Left or Right.
entries.zh: 林克走路、跑步与游泳的速度倍率。用左／右方向键调整。

entries.en: How fast the letters of dialogue and other messages appear.
entries.zh: 对白和其他消息中 文字出现的速度。

entries.en: How large the text of dialogue, Navi and signs is drawn.
entries.zh: 对话、奈维与路牌文字的显示大小。

entries.en: How large this menu, the FPS counter and the start-up screen are drawn.
entries.zh: 本菜单、FPS 计数器和启动画面的显示大小。

entries.en: How loud the game plays. The game's own sound settings and Windows' volume still apply.
entries.zh: 游戏播放音量。游戏自带声音设置与 Windows 音量仍然生效。

entries.en: How slow a turn counts as none, the console's three settings: Standard is its own. High steadies a pad that jitters when held still; Low keeps the smallest movements.
entries.zh: 多慢的转动算作没有动作， 对应主机的三档设置：标准为主机自身设定。 高可稳住 静止时抖动的手柄；低保留最细微的动作。

entries.en: How strongly the controller rumbles, in percent of the game's rumble. Off turns it off.
entries.zh: 手柄震动强度，按游戏原强度的百分比计算。关 表示关闭。

entries.en: How the captured mouse turns the camera.
entries.zh: 被捕获的鼠标 如何转动镜头。

entries.en: How the finished picture is scaled to the window, when its size differs from the Output resolution.
entries.zh: 当窗口尺寸 与输出分辨率不同时，把成品画面 缩放到窗口的方式。

entries.en: How the game keeps time when it runs below 60 fps.
entries.zh: 游戏低于 60 fps 时 如何保持时间。

entries.en: How the game's mesh programs (much of the scenery) run: on the GPU's own mesh shaders, or as compute shaders, which every GPU has. Applies after a restart.
entries.zh: 决定游戏的网格程序（大部分场景）如何运行：用 GPU 自带的网格着色器，或用所有显卡都支持的计算着色器。重启后生效。

entries.en: Inverts horizontal look (left/right) on the right analog stick.
entries.zh: 反转右摇杆的左右视角方向。

entries.en: Inverts vertical look (up/down) on the right analog stick.
entries.zh: 反转右摇杆的上下视角方向。

entries.en: Keeps textures sharp on surfaces seen at a slant, such as the ground ahead: higher is sharper in the distance, for a little GPU time. Game's is the console's own (1x or 2x).
entries.zh: 让斜视表面（如前方的地面）纹理保持清晰：数值越高远处越锐利，代价是少量 GPU 时间。「游戏原始」指主机自带的 1x 或 2x。

entries.en: Larger, for a TV across the room.
entries.zh: 更大，适合隔着房间看电视。

entries.en: Lets DLSS's runtime pick for each mode: what it picks can change with a runtime update.
entries.zh: 由 DLSS 运行库按各模式自行挑选：运行库更新后 选择可能变化。

entries.en: Limits frames rendered by the game. Generated frames are additional. Takes a restart. Past 60 is experimental: the game keeps real time, but some cutscenes and bosses can misbehave (Gohma, the intro's narration). 60 is the safe choice.
entries.zh: 限制游戏本体渲染的帧数，生成的插帧另算。改后需重启。超过 60 属实验性：游戏仍按真实时间运行，但部分过场与 Boss 可能异常（哥玛、开场旁白）。60 是稳妥选择。

entries.en: Load a save to edit the inventory.
entries.zh: 读取存档后才能编辑背包。

entries.en: Load a save to edit this item.
entries.zh: 读取存档后才能编辑此道具。

entries.en: Makes frames between the game's own, for smoother motion, at a little input delay. Fast motion or camera cuts can show artifacts.
entries.zh: 在游戏自身帧之间 生成中间帧，让运动更连贯， 但会增加一点输入延迟。 快速运动或镜头切换 可能出现拖影。

entries.en: Motion controls: aiming with the controller's gyroscope, its sensitivity and its inverts.
entries.zh: 体感操作：用手柄陀螺仪瞄准， 以及灵敏度与反转设置。

entries.en: Move and look with your usual controls. Page Up / Page Down or R / L changes height.
entries.zh: 用常规操作移动和观察视角。Page Up / Page Down 或 R / L 改变高度。

entries.en: Moving the mouse forward tilts the camera down.
entries.zh: 向前移动鼠标时 镜头向下倾斜。

entries.en: NVIDIA GPUs: each frame starts as late as it can, for less input delay. Not used with frame generation.
entries.zh: NVIDIA 显卡：让每帧尽可能晚地开始，以降低输入延迟。 开启插帧时不生效。

entries.en: NVIDIA's second-generation transformer, its pick for Performance: sharper, at a little more GPU time.
entries.zh: NVIDIA 第二代变换模型，其性能档选择：更锐利，但 GPU 耗时略增。

entries.en: NVIDIA's transformer model: the one tested most here.
entries.zh: NVIDIA 的变换模型：本项目测试最多的一个。

entries.en: Normal speed down to 15 fps, by taking longer steps.
entries.zh: 通过延长每步时间，在 15 fps 以上保持正常速度。

entries.en: Not plugged in: Default stands in until it is back.
entries.zh: 未接入：恢复前暂由默认设备代替。

entries.en: Off: the picture as it is.
One made frame between each two of the game's, by AMD FSR 3.1 from the scene's depth and motion.
entries.zh: 用 AMD FSR 3.1 依据场景深度和运动，在游戏每两帧之间生成一帧。

entries.en: Only the game's own frames: no added delay.
entries.zh: 只显示游戏自身的帧：不增加延迟。

entries.en: Only while the game's window has the focus.
entries.zh: 仅在游戏窗口获得焦点时。

entries.en: Opens the map list. Link travels through the game's own map change, in his current age.
entries.zh: 打开地图列表。林克按游戏自身的地图切换流程前往，并保持当前年龄。
第 %d 页 / 共 %d 页

entries.en: Press the gamepad button to use. Esc cancels.
entries.zh: 按下要使用的手柄按键。Esc 取消。

entries.en: Press the key to use. Esc cancels.
entries.zh: 按下要使用的键盘按键。Esc 取消。

entries.en: Progress since your last save is lost.
entries.zh: 上次存档后的进度将丢失。

entries.en: Protects Link's hearts. Hits can still knock him back.
entries.zh: 保护林克的心，受击仍会被击退。

entries.en: Remember Link's position for this loaded scene.
entries.zh: 记录林克在当前场景中的位置。

entries.en: Runs the game as the console docked or handheld. Applies after a restart.
entries.zh: 以主机底座模式或掌机模式运行游戏。重启后生效。

entries.en: Save your progress first. Press Enter or A twice to quit. Esc or B cancels.
entries.zh: 请先保存进度。连按两次回车或 A 确认退出，Esc 或 B 取消。

entries.en: Select a destination, then Travel (or Enter) to go to its map entrance. Link keeps his current age.
entries.zh: 选择目的地，然后按「传送」（或回车）前往该地图入口。林克保持当前年龄。

entries.en: Set for this run by RX_VK_DLSS_PRESET.
Sets the scaling rows and memory limits for a GPU with that much memory. The Upscaler and Frame generation stay yours.
entries.zh: 按显存大小设置缩放档位和显存上限。缩放器与插帧仍由你自己决定。

entries.en: Sharpens the picture as it goes to the window, with any filter. Too much shows halos around edges.
entries.zh: 画面输出到窗口时锐化，可配合任意滤镜。 过高会在边缘出现光晕。

entries.en: Sharper still; can ring on edges.
entries.zh: 更锐利；边缘可能出现振铃。

entries.en: Shows "Playing Hookshot" and the time played in your Discord status, while Discord runs on this PC.
entries.zh: 本机运行 Discord 时 在其状态中显示正在玩 Hookshot 和游戏时长。

entries.en: Silences the game while another window has the focus. The sound comes back when you switch to the game.
entries.zh: 其他窗口获得焦点时静音，切回游戏时自动恢复。

entries.en: Starts the game again. Save your progress first. Press Enter or A twice to restart. Esc or B cancels.
entries.zh: 重新启动游戏。请先保存进度。连按两次回车或 A 确认重启，Esc 或 B 取消。
无论设备如何，都用立体声。

entries.en: Stops the camera gradually turning toward the direction you move, useful with native mouse look. Off keeps the game's standard behavior. Manual camera controls and recentering still work.
entries.zh: 阻止镜头随移动方向缓慢转回正前方，配合原生鼠标视角时很有用。关闭则保持游戏默认行为；手动视角控制与回中仍可用。

entries.en: Swaps Link between child and adult and reloads this map in the other age (the Market when this map has no match).
entries.zh: 在少年与成年林克之间切换，并以另一年龄重新载入本图（无对应地图时 载入集市）。

entries.en: Swaps up and down for the mouse.
entries.zh: 把鼠标的上下方向对调。

entries.en: Switch Pro controllers and pads in Switch mode, DualSense and DualShock 4. The value says whether the connected pad has a gyroscope.
entries.zh: 支持 Switch Pro 手柄、Switch 模式手柄、DualSense 和 DualShock 4。 该值表示所连接手柄是否有陀螺仪。

entries.en: Teleport Link to the marked position in the current scene.
entries.zh: 把林克传送到当前场景中标记的位置。

entries.en: Testing tools: no-clip flight, a free camera, teleport, Link's age, the inventory, the clock, heart protection and movement speed. Off puts flight, the free camera and heart protection away and Link back to his own speed.
entries.zh: 测试工具：穿墙飞行、自由视角、传送、林克年龄、背包、世界时钟、生命保护与移动速度。关闭时会收起飞行、自由视角和生命保护，并把林克速度恢复正常。

entries.en: The 3D at the output's full size: the sharpest, and the slowest.
entries.zh: 3D 以输出分辨率全尺寸绘制：最清晰，也最慢。

entries.en: The GPU's own mesh shaders for every draw. A GPU without them still uses the compute path.
entries.zh: 每次绘制都用显卡原生网格着色器；不支持的显卡仍走计算着色器路径。

entries.en: The GPU's own mesh shaders where it has them, the compute path where it has not.
entries.zh: 显卡支持时使用原生网格着色器，不支持时走计算着色器路径。

entries.en: The Switch's order: A on the right, B at the bottom, X at the top, Y on the left.
entries.zh: Switch 布局：A 在右、B 在下、X 在上、Y 在左。

entries.en: The brightest highlights with HDR on: set it to your display's peak brightness.
entries.zh: 开启 HDR 时的最高高光亮度：请设为显示器的峰值亮度。

entries.en: The button icons the game shows, in its texts and menus: those of this controller, for the buttons your controls put each action on.
entries.zh: 游戏文字和菜单中 显示的按键图标：按当前手柄样式， 并显示你在控制设置里 给各动作绑定的按键。

entries.en: The camera takes the screen's shape, wider or narrower. The HUD keeps its 16:9 shape in the middle.
entries.zh: 镜头适配屏幕比例，可宽可窄；HUD 在中间保持 16:9。

entries.en: The camera's shape on a screen wider or narrower than 16:9 (4:3, 16:10). Applies after a restart.
entries.zh: 在比 16:9 更宽或更窄的屏幕上（4:3、16:10）设定镜头比例。 重启后生效。

entries.en: The compute path on every GPU: try it if your card crashes or leaves objects out. Usually a little slower.
entries.zh: 所有显卡都走计算着色器路径：若显卡崩溃或物体缺失可尝试此项，通常略慢。

entries.en: The driver delays each frame's start for less latency.
entries.zh: 驱动延后每帧的开始时机，以降低延迟。

entries.en: The driver paces the frames for less latency.
entries.zh: 由驱动控制帧节奏，降低延迟。

entries.en: The game lowers it when the GPU is busy, and FSR follows.
entries.zh: GPU 繁忙时 游戏会自动降低，FSR 随之调整。

entries.en: The game lowers it when the GPU is busy.
entries.zh: GPU 繁忙时 游戏会自动降低。

entries.en: The game's own pace, with its pauses.
entries.zh: 游戏自身的节奏，包含其停顿。

entries.en: The game's whole frame, HUD included, before it is scaled to the window. Docked only. Applies after a restart.
entries.zh: 缩放到窗口之前的完整画面，包含 HUD。 仅底座模式。 重启后生效。

entries.en: The language the menu is drawn in. The game's own language (its dialogue and signs) is unchanged. Applies at once.
entries.zh: 菜单所用的显示语言。游戏本体的语言（对话与标牌）不受影响。立即生效。

entries.en: The layout preset, the button prompts, and which gamepad button and which keys press each of the Switch's buttons.
entries.zh: 布局预设、按键提示，以及 Switch 各按键对应的手柄键和键盘键。

entries.en: The menus in the middle 16:9; beside them, what the game draws there, out of focus.
entries.zh: 菜单居中保持 16:9；两侧显示游戏画面并做虚化。

entries.en: The menus in the middle 16:9; black beside them.
entries.zh: 菜单居中保持 16:9；两侧为黑边。

entries.en: The menus stretched over the whole screen, as before.
entries.zh: 菜单像以前一样拉伸铺满整个屏幕。

entries.en: The mouse stands in for the right stick, with its curve and top speed.
entries.zh: 鼠标代替右摇杆，沿用其曲线和最高速度。

entries.en: The mouse turns the camera itself, one to one, as in a PC game.
entries.zh: 鼠标直接一对一转动镜头，与 PC 游戏一致。

entries.en: The second-generation transformer as NVIDIA tuned it for Ultra Performance, the smallest Render resolutions.
entries.zh: NVIDIA 为极速档（最小渲染分辨率） 调校的第二代变换模型。

entries.en: The share of the output the 3D is drawn at; the Upscaler fills in the rest.
entries.zh: 3D 画面按输出分辨率的多少比例绘制； 其余由缩放器补全。

entries.en: The sharpest on a 1920x1080 screen: the HUD and text pixel for pixel, nothing to scale to the window.
entries.zh: 在 1920x1080 屏幕上最清晰：HUD 和文字逐像素对应，无需缩放到窗口。

entries.en: The sharpest on a 2560x1440 screen: nothing to scale to the window.
entries.zh: 在 2560x1440 屏幕上最清晰：无需缩放到窗口。

entries.en: The sharpest on a 3840x2160 screen. The game's render targets get a bigger GPU pool, so a full-size 3D fits.
entries.zh: 在 3840x2160 屏幕上最清晰。 渲染目标获得更大显存池，可容纳全尺寸 3D。

entries.en: The sharpest on a 5120x1440 ultrawide screen: the whole frame pixel for pixel. The game's render targets get a bigger GPU pool, so a full-size 3D fits.
entries.zh: 在 5120x1440 超宽屏上最清晰：整帧逐像素对应。 渲染目标获得更大显存池，可容纳全尺寸 3D。

entries.en: The sharpest on a 5120x2880 (5K) screen: the whole frame pixel for pixel. The game's render targets get a bigger GPU pool, so a full-size 3D fits.
entries.zh: 在 5120x2880（5K）屏幕上最锐利：整帧逐像素输出。游戏渲染目标获得更大的显存池，足以容纳全尺寸 3D。

entries.en: The speakers the game mixes its sound for. Applies after a restart.
entries.zh: 游戏按哪种扬声器配置混音。 重启后生效。

entries.en: The system's default recording device. On Windows, desktop apps must be allowed to use the microphone (Settings, Privacy & security).
entries.zh: 系统默认录音设备。 Windows 上需允许桌面应用使用麦克风（设置 > 隐私和安全性）。

entries.en: The window is the Output resolution's size: nothing to scale. The choice is kept for another size.
entries.zh: 窗口与输出分辨率尺寸相同：无需缩放。 该选择会保留，供其它尺寸使用。

entries.en: This microphone, by its name. A change applies at once.
entries.zh: 按名称指定的这支麦克风。 更改立即生效。

entries.en: Those of the first controller, from its name (SDL's). The Switch's when it has none, as with XInput alone.
entries.zh: 按第一支手柄的名称（SDL）显示其图标。 无法识别时用 Switch 图标，例如仅有 XInput 时。

entries.en: Turns the motion aim's left and right around.
entries.zh: 把体感瞄准的左右方向对调。

entries.en: Turns the motion aim's up and down around.
entries.zh: 把体感瞄准的上下方向对调。
解锁或重新锁定此道具。

entries.en: Used by NVIDIA DLSS and DLAA: choose one in the Upscaler row.
entries.zh: 供 NVIDIA DLSS 与 DLAA 使用：在缩放器行里选择。

entries.en: What a sampler holds is kept beside it on the replay thread, so resolving a sampler that was not registered anew takes no lock. Helps while the game streams textures. Applies after restart.
entries.zh: 采样器内容 保存在回放线程旁边，因此重新解析 未重新注册的采样器 无需加锁。 在游戏流式加载纹理时有帮助。 重启后生效。

entries.en: What scales the 3D up to the Output resolution.
entries.zh: 把 3D 画面放大到输出分辨率的方式。

entries.en: What the ocarina hears when the game's microphone option is on (playing an instrument, or humming).
entries.zh: 开启游戏内麦克风选项时 陶笛听到的内容（演奏乐器或哼唱）。

entries.en: Whether the controller plays the game while another window has the focus.
entries.zh: 焦点在其它窗口时 手柄是否仍能操作游戏。

entries.en: Which face button is which. Binding one yourself on the Controls page makes it Custom.
entries.zh: 哪个面键对应哪个功能。 在控制页面自行绑定后会变为自定义。

entries.en: Which gamepad button and which keys press each of the Switch's buttons. Enter binds the one selected; Delete clears it. The game's button icons follow after a restart.
entries.zh: 设定哪个手柄按键和键盘按键对应 Switch 的各按钮。回车绑定当前选中项，Delete 清除。游戏内的按键图标在重启后同步。

entries.en: Which graphics card the game runs on. Applies after a restart.
entries.zh: 游戏使用哪块显卡运行。 重启后生效。

entries.en: Which keys open and close this menu. F1 always does; F1 only leaves Insert free for an overlay. With Esc, Esc opens it too, as a PC game's pause menu (open, Esc still goes back a page or closes it).
entries.zh: 用哪些按键开关本菜单。F1 始终可用；「仅 F1」把 Insert 让给其他叠加层。选 Esc 时 Esc 也能打开，像 PC 游戏的暂停菜单（打开后 Esc 仍用于返回上一页或关闭）。

entries.en: Which of NVIDIA's DLSS networks draws the picture.
entries.zh: 选择由 NVIDIA 的哪套 DLSS 网络绘制画面。

entries.en: With Ultrawide: the pause, item and map menus, and what shows beside them. Loading screens and pre-rendered movies, which draw no world either, get the same sides. Changes at once.
entries.zh: 开启超宽屏后作用于暂停、道具、地图菜单及其两侧内容。加载画面与预渲染影片（同样不绘制世界）也采用相同的两侧处理。立即生效。

entries.en: With frame generation on, the game's own rate too.
entries.zh: 开启插帧时 游戏自身帧率也一并计算。

entries.en: Your own size, from output_res= in hookshot_options.ini.
entries.zh: 自定义尺寸，取自 hookshot_options.ini 中的 output_res=。
